reviews.text: Easy to use. Easily accesible compared to using the software on the laptop or desktops. Love the fact that the app can connect the users to contact our customers all from the app itself. Highly recommended to Financio users to use the app.

reviews.text: I would say Financio is the best accounting software which I know so far. Their recent launch CONNECT mobile app is very much welcomed. It help me who is on-the-go person and multitasking. I can just send out invoice, bill and quote at my fingertips. Another encouraging things about the app, I can get all the contacts that have been save in the app and the best things I can directly call my clients and get direction to their locations just a click away. This app also enable me to do accounting work even when I'm outstation and don't have my laptop with me. Plus, I can also provide a quick report to my boss from the summary given in the dashboard.
reviews.reply: Hi Eunice, thank you for your encouraging words. We're really glad you enjoyed our CONNECT mobile app. Your review means a lot to us and lets us know we’re on the right track! We’re very grateful for customers like you and hope you stick with us for years to come!

reviews.text: Easy and convenient invoicing on the go...very handy and useful to access customer's sales info while away from office. Recommended for all sales personnel who works away from office. App is easy to use and is customizable. Most important is app is steady and doesn't lag and have secure log in. Would love to have features to search customers sales records and current sales statements. Hope to see future improvement to make this app great
reviews.reply: Hi Eddie, thanks for taking the time to write this awesome feedback. We will continue to work on adding more features to our app.

reviews.text: UI is nice. But your app is extremely buggy and unusable. Sync doesn't work well. Payment keyed in on Web is not synced on the app. Dashboard shows 2 open invoices but when you click on it, there are actually 3 open invoices. Sending invoice via the app is not available (in Msia). I mainly take Progress Payments - this is setup on Web but on the app, the term doesn't exist in the selection. When I go to Invoices, select "ALL" and scroll down, it's an endless loop of "loading more data". Pls fix.
reviews.reply: Sorry to hear that! Could you write to us at support@financio.co with more details of your issue? We'd love to contact you directly regarding this matter.
